description: Detection patterns for cipher-based prompt injection attacks. Defensive reference for guard implementations, not bypass tools.
scope: DEFENSE_ONLY - used by guard/filter implementations to identify and block cipher-encoded jailbreak attempts
attribution: Synthesized from academic paper: RobustNLP/CipherChat (Yuan et al., 2024) - arXiv:2408.16718

patterns.name: ROT13 Detection
patterns.description: Detect prompts containing ROT13-encoded text requesting the model to decode and respond
detection_hints: Contains 'decode this' followed by alphabetic characters with no spaces
Asks model to 'apply rot13' or 'rotate by 13'
patterns.defense_recommendation: Block prompts requesting model to decode and execute ROT13-encoded instructions. ROT13 alone is not a secret - models can decode it trivially.

patterns.name: Atbash Cipher Detection
patterns.description: Detect Hebrew atbash cipher (A<->Z, B<->Y mapping) used to obfuscate harmful requests
detection_hints: Reversed alphabet patterns in user text
patterns.defense_recommendation: Detect atbash-encoded harmful requests. Block when decoded content matches known harm categories.

patterns.name: Caesar Cipher Detection
patterns.description: Detect Caesar shift cipher with variable offset (1-25) used to obfuscate requests
detection_hints: Asks model to 'shift by N' or 'shift back by N'
Provides encoded text and asks for decoding
patterns.defense_recommendation: Block Caesar shift requests. Try all 25 possible shifts against content classifier.

patterns.name: Binary Encoding Detection
patterns.description: Detect prompts containing binary (0/1) representations of text requesting decoding
detection_hints: Long strings of 0s and 1s (8+ char sequences) without context
patterns.defense_recommendation: Block prompts with long binary sequences. Run content classifier on decoded binary before processing.

patterns.name: Hex Encoding Detection
patterns.description: Detect prompts with hex-encoded content requesting decode-and-execute
detection_hints: Hex-looking strings (0-9a-f pairs, 16+ chars) without context
patterns.defense_recommendation: Block hex-encoded instruction sequences. Decode and content-classify before processing.

patterns.name: Morse Code Detection
patterns.description: Detect Morse code sequences (dots and dashes) in user prompts
patterns.defense_recommendation: Block morse-encoded content. Run content classifier on decoded text.

patterns.name: Pig Latin Detection
patterns.description: Detect Pig Latin (English with -ay suffix) used to obfuscate harmful words
detection_hints: Multiple words ending in -ay that are not actual English
patterns.defense_recommendation: Pig Latin is weak obfuscation. Translate and content-classify.

patterns.name: String Reversal Detection
patterns.description: Detect reversed text strings used to bypass keyword filters
detection_hints: Words with no vowels in standard positions
Asks to 'read backwards' or 'reverse the text'
patterns.defense_recommendation: Reverse and content-classify. Simple defense - reverse is trivial to undo.

patterns.name: Self-Defined Cipher
patterns.description: Detect user-defined cipher systems provided in the prompt itself
detection_hints: Prompt defines a substitution or mapping rule
Asks model to apply custom transformation
patterns.defense_recommendation: Block prompts that define their own encoding scheme. This is a strong signal of jailbreak attempt.

patterns.name: Unicode Obfuscation
patterns.description: Detect Unicode characters that visually resemble ASCII (homoglyphs, zero-width chars)
detection_hints: Homoglyphs (Cyrillic, Greek, etc. in Latin text)
patterns.defense_recommendation: Normalize Unicode to ASCII before content classification. Reject mixed-script text.

patterns.name: Base64 Decoding Request
patterns.description: Detect prompts asking model to decode Base64 and execute the result
patterns.defense_recommendation: Decode and content-classify before processing. Block if decoded text is harmful.

patterns.name: Leetspeak / Character Substitution
patterns.description: Detect leetspeak (1337) or character substitution (a→@, e→3, etc.)
detection_hints: High density of digits in word positions
patterns.defense_recommendation: Normalize leetspeak to plain text before classification. Use a leet to ASCII dictionary.

patterns.name: Translation Pivot Attack
patterns.description: Detect prompts that translate request to low-resource language and ask for response back
detection_hints: Mentions translation between English and another language
Asks for response 'in English' after providing foreign text
Low-resource language like Zulu, Welsh, Maori
patterns.defense_recommendation: Apply content classification in original language. Many LLMs have weaker safety in non-English.

patterns.name: Acrostic / First-Letter Cipher
patterns.description: Detect prompts where first letters of each line/word form a hidden message
patterns.defense_recommendation: Run content classification on extracted acrostic text. Hard to defend against at the prompt level.

patterns.name: Emoji Substitution
patterns.description: Detect prompts using emoji to substitute for harmful words
patterns.defense_recommendation: Translate emoji to semantic concepts and run content classification.

usage_notes.purpose: This is a DEFENSIVE catalog. Use these patterns to build guard/filter implementations that BLOCK or DETECT cipher-based jailbreak attempts.
usage_notes.not_a_tool: This file is NOT for generating bypass prompts. It is for building defenses against them.
usage_notes.integration: Import this file in your guard implementation. Run pattern detection BEFORE sending user input to the model. Block or flag when patterns match.
usage_notes.citation: Patterns inspired by: Yuan et al. (2024). 'CipherChat: An Interactive Visual Chat System Based on Cipher Code'. arXiv:2408.16718
